In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 14.0 to 14.8 s same overhead creek. The white car sits where the brown water meets the lower cream bank on the right and creeps a short distance left with a slight rotation by 14.8 s. Soft rounded white foam blobs cluster at its right end. The water shows thin wavy white lines of varied length, some about a third of the creek width, with small ripples along them, plus scattered dots; they are wiggly rather than straight and are not shaped as a V behind the car. No visible lift or shadow separation in these frames. Car remains above the caption box. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
